executor_contract.insulated-execute: Insula candidate checker executes this pure argv.
executor_contract.prepared-host-fixture-receipt: Lead executes host argv during preparation; copies immutable sanitized raw receipt bundle under the single /outputs/fixtures/<pilot> subtree. Offline checker only compares.
executor_contract.prepilot-live-fixture-receipt: Lead executes actual prepilot fixture at candidate admitted base before its worker launches. Includes its entire acknowledged-turn-result stream.
executor_contract.actual-pilot-receipt: Actual bound outer worker/lead operation; source/thread/turn/item provenance corroborated. No extra launch by checker.

integrity_contract: Independent auditor proves candidate diff stays in admitted document directory and helper/manifest/auditor blob IDs equal admitted base. Candidate cannot amend its own acceptance.
